items.html: And see, in the matter of the Ibur [conception] of ZA, how at the time of its birth there can be no opening of the womb without blood — these are the parts called dross in relation to Atzilut. And this dross and blood returns to be sorted in Beria; and that which is dross in relation to Beria returns to be sorted in Yetzira; and in this manner in each and every degree. And this suffices. And afterwards, in this manner, from the worse in Yetzira; and afterwards from the worst of them all in Assiya, according to the order of its degrees as well. For all the parts of these three worlds BYA are all the Nukva, and there is no male among them at all; and even the males in them are but forces of the Nukva, as is known, for they are all the armies of Malchut and her hosts. And they were all made from these sortings of the seven kings, in the aforementioned manner.
